items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ

transliteration.en: Bismillāh, tawakkaltu ʿalā Allāh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh

translation.en: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.

text.en: Whoever says, when he leaves his house, "In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah," it is said to him: you are guided, sufficed and protected.
text.ar: مَنْ قَالَ ـ يَعْنِي إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ ـ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ، يُقَالُ لَهُ هُدِيتَ وَكُفِيتَ وَوُقِيتَ
